releases.displayName: METRO Redux Next-Gen Update Patch Notes for METRO 2033 & Last Light

items.text: The METRO Redux Next-Gen Update is live now, bringing a huge number of visual and performance upgrades to METRO 2033 & METRO Last Light!
PC players can look forward to playing both games at 4K resolution with uncapped frame rates, alongside DLSS and Spatial Audio support.
These visual and performance improvements are accompanied by a host of bug fixes and title-specific tweaks. You'll find the full patch notes outlining every change towards the end of this article.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6058500/cbcc82c36e64efc6e0024e00c0b33ba9271a8957.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6058500/ab20a2109b2817a0aceb8049c0b146e6c4f29f18.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6058500/066a34237ee626525c6039b458f0fa28115b2ba2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6058500/628fc7eda6a931dac3e62f8e722b45a69acbf5bc.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6058500/cac7a13cb73b6743fadd01159c9badb99189082c.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6058500/643e19352378498b13918905b0c2b0853f90362f.jpg"]
Exclusive Rewards for Deep Silver Account Members
As well as enhancing the modern METRO universe for the latest gaming hardware, the Redux update also brings Deep Silver Account support to both METRO 2033 and METRO Last Light.

First added to METRO Exodus at Gamescom, you can now link your Deep Silver Account to one or more of these three titles to unlock an exclusive comic book! Simply follow the in-game QR code and then sign in to your Deep Silver Account to receive your reward.

For each of the three games you link, you'll also receive a competition entry to win a copy of METRO 2039, launching on February 4th, 2027. You'll receive a further competition entry for signing up to the Deep Silver newsletter, giving you up to four chances to win.
(Full terms and conditions for the METRO 2039 competition are available here.)
METRO Redux Patch Notes
Here are the full patch notes for each individual platform, as well as title-specific tweaks for both METRO 2033 Redux and METRO Last Light Redux.
PC (Steam, Epic, GoG)
Unbound FPS (depends on hardware)
4A TSR (ANY), DLSS (NVIDIA), and FSR (AMD) support
DLSS Support
Screen Space Global Illumination
Increased geometry details
Increased texture details
Support 4k textures
Improved PBR materials
Fixed bugs related to high FPS
Improved animation quality
Improved sound quality
Spatial audio support
Community bugfixes as noted below
Adaptive triggers for DualSense
Impulse triggers for Xbox Controller
Fixed bug with different horizontal and vertical sensitivity for mouse
Power optimized mode for Xbox Ally/X and Microsoft Store version
Epic - Integrated EOS (Achievements, Accounts)
*4K support requires a 4K Monitor
Community-Reported Bug Fixes
Stability
Improved stability on modern PC hardware (Windows 11, AMD GPUs, high-refresh-rate displays), including crashes during chapter transitions and on launch.
Fixed a crash when picking up a gas mask.
Fixed hard freezes at splash screens, on "Press Any Button" and during chapter loads.
Fixed infinite loading screens and black screens after the intro logos, particularly on newer AMD hardware.
Fixed freezes during level transitions and scripted sequences, and crashes with newer graphics drivers.
Gameplay
Fixed the weapon getting stuck in an endless reload animation and being unable to fire if burning cobwebs was interrupted by reloading or switching weapons.
Fixed enemies detecting the player through darkness and through walls, and their alert state escalating instantly.
Saves
Fixed Steam Cloud not uploading save data.
The game no longer creates a checkpoint when the player has too little filter time left. This prevents saves where the player suffocates before they can find more filters.
Fixed save corruption on PS5 that made later chapters (after "Regina") unavailable and reset inventory after the console had been powered off for a long period.
Fixed crashes and infinite loading when loading a checkpoint, including after repeated reloads.
Improved save reliability when the game is quit or interrupted while autosaving.
Fixed checkpoints being created when the player had too few filters, which could trap the player in a death loop.
Fixed save files disappearing, "Continue" loading an older checkpoint, and saves becoming corrupted after a crash or improper shutdown.
Controls
Restored default keyboard bindings that were missing after a previous update.
Fixed the DualSense Wireless Controller not being recognized in the Steam version.
Fixed the mouse cursor getting stuck at the edge of the screen in menus and vendor screens on multi-monitor setups.
Fixed Xbox controllers only being partially detected, and button remapping failures.
Display & Settings
Advanced PhysX is now enabled by default on PC.
Fixed the title screen displaying incorrectly if the game lost focus straight after launch.
Fixed the game not starting in full screen on first launch on 4K monitors with display scaling enabled.
Fixed missing modern resolutions (such as 1440p and 4K) and the game being limited to legacy resolutions like 1600x1200.
Fixed fullscreen not working, and fixed stretched images and incorrect aspect ratios on high-resolution monitors.
Improved lighting and shadow quality, fixing pixelated bloom, broken shadows, missing volumetric lighting and white halo artifacts (e.g. Hunter intro, searchlights, backlit corridors).
Fixed flickering shadows, shimmering textures, unstable SSAO and broken post-processing on modern GPUs and ultrawide displays.
METRO 2033 Redux
Fixed the Demon freezing in mid-air during its grab attack in "Outpost".
Improved performance in "Torchlight".
Fixed being unable to collect the weapon from the armorer at the start of the game, which blocked progress.
Fixed Khan and his men freezing in place or firing endlessly after the player plants the bomb in "Khan" (Turgenevskaya), and fixed the freeze / black screen when loading the last checkpoint there.
Fixed the player getting stuck with no cutscene after finishing the encounter in "Library".
Fixed the crane, magnet and lever mechanisms near the end of the game not responding in "D6".
Fixed the ending cutscene not playing after finishing the game.
Fixed instant death in toxic areas even with the gas mask on.
Fixed achievements not unlocking even though their requirements were met, including "Armorer".
Fixed achievement progress made offline not syncing after reconnecting.
METRO Last Light Redux
Fixed the bear staying knocked out during the boss fight in "The Garden", which blocked progress.
Fixed stealth knockouts and kills being unavailable from the "Revolution" chapter onwards.
Fixed a crash when buying the RPK into an empty third weapon slot at the Venice armory.
Fixed being unable to progress in the "Khan" DLC after Khan wakes Ulman from the visions.
Fixed the player ending up out of bounds after falling into the water in "Nightfall”.
General note when upgrading the Microsoft Store version only:
Saves will not carry over to the upgraded version and a New Game start is recommended.
Chapter select will be unlocked to contain each chapter and you can start any chapter with a default set of equipment if desired.

releases.displayName: METRO Redux | Next-Gen Update coming this month

items.text: We are excited to confirm that the METRO franchise has reached a significant milestone in its journey – we have officially sold 50 million copies of METRO games across the globe. We couldn’t be more proud of how far we have come from our debut release METRO 2033 16 years ago, and how our players have grown and supported us through everything since. As we approach our next big release, your excitement and enthusiasm has meant so much to us, and it inspires us every day.

As a huge thank you to our players, we’re announcing that a free update is coming for all owners of METRO 2033 Redux and METRO Last Light Redux that makes several improvements and enhancements for modern hardware.

For our longstanding Metro-dwellers, now has never been a better opportunity to return to the Metro tunnels. To relive the story, the action and feel the weight of the cold foreboding tunnels stretching ahead of you, filled with unknown horrors and adventure. Why not try a different playthrough approach this time round and get a different ending using the Karma system? Or simply immerse yourself back into the beautifully destroyed world.
For new players, it’s time to join the 50 million players who fell in love with our acclaimed METRO storytelling and prepare yourself for what’s in store for METRO 2039 come February 4th.

So, what have we done? This is not a full remaster or remake - the original METRO Redux experience and aesthetic has been preserved - but we have made careful, meaningful improvements to take advantage of the latest PC and console hardware. All platforms will include support for 4K textures, bringing greater depth and atmosphere to the haunting world of METRO. The update enhances gameplay immersion through improved animation fidelity, higher-quality audio and richer environmental detail. We have also managed to implement a range of community led bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.

The METRO Redux Next-Gen Update adds native support for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S, alongside platform-specific enhancements such as PSSR support on PlayStation 5 Pro, TSR upscaling and anti-aliasing support on Xbox Series X, and Spatial Audio support on Xbox platforms. Players on console can experience true 4K at 60FPS and upscaled 4K at 120FPS (with the right monitor or TV hardware), higher quality lighting, shadows and particle effects. Plus, we are supporting Adaptive Triggers for DualSense controllers and Impulse Triggers on Xbox controllers. Players will also benefit from hardware tessellation and displacement at runtime on consoles, Power Optimized Mode on Xbox and Power Saver Mode support for PlayStation.
With Xbox Handheld and Xbox Play Anywhere support, the journey through the Metro can continue wherever you choose.
For PC we have implemented DLSS support, spatial audio support as well as increased quality of life community bugfixes and frequently asked for improvements.
Full patch notes detailing all technical improvements and platform-specific features will be revealed at launch, so this is just a taste for now.

Coming October 22, 2026, for PC, October 29, 2026, on consoles*, free for all existing owners of METRO 2033 Redux and METRO Last Light Redux on Steam, Epic Games Store, Windows Store, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
*this November to Japanese players on console.
